canonical_target_boundary.candidate_interpretation: For every n, partitions of n classify isomorphism classes of irreducible finite-dimensional complex representations of the finite symmetric group.
canonical_target_boundary.credit_rule: Candidates are compared only with this explicitly provisional interpretation. No match can repair or bypass the unresolved statement-source gate.

sources: the complete manifest-pinned Lean package closure
content-bound public discovery observations retained by the repository-local legacy audit
target-owned source crosswalk and statement rechecks
Burnside 1900/1911 and Young 1900/1901 bibliographic leads recorded by prior bounded searches

alias_families: irreducible representations of the symmetric group

selection_rules.exact: An exact candidate must first identify the same source-authorized proposition and then preserve the coefficient field, finite-dimensionality, range of n, group model, representation equivalence, construction, and boundary cases, or provide a checked transport.
selection_rules.supporting: Partitions, Young diagrams, tableaux, permutation groups, representation bundles, irreducibility predicates, and conditional proof-package wrappers are classified independently and receive no root proof credit.
selection_rules.placeholder: A declaration with a direct or transitive placeholder, bodyless or unapproved axiom, unsafe/oracle boundary, or unknown terminal body is M5 for root-credit purposes.
selection_rules.negative_evidence: Every negative lane binds its query or source, immutable revision or tracked bytes, observation boundary, and reopen condition. Access failure is not interpreted as a zero-result search.
selection_rules.deduplication: Aliases, wrappers, copied metadata, and declarations sharing one terminal body count once for proof credit.

network_policy: denied for worker replay; no clone, fetch, update, build, or moving-reference query is part of this inventory
immutable_refresh_policy: A newly supplied immutable candidate, admitted primary passage, or changed source/pin creates an append-only inventory version and invalidates this one.
